title: chenopodium glaucum subsp. ambiguum
intro: Chenopodium glaucum subsp. ambiguum, commonly known as a subspecies of the lamb's quarters or fat-hen plant, is a plant species within the Chenopodium genus. This plant is believed to offer several health benefits, including its potential to aid in the treatment of various ailments such as fever, rheumatism, and gastrointestinal issues, due to its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties. The therapeutic actions of Chenopodium glaucum subsp. ambiguum are thought to be attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which may contribute to its medicinal properties. While the bioactive constituents of Chenopodium glaucum subsp. ambiguum have not been extensively studied, the plant is often used in folk medicine for its perceived health benefits.
